vision: Enable international expansion by migrating customer profiles from PostgreSQL to MongoDB, supporting flexible country-specific data and zero downtime. This will reduce schema management overhead and ensure full backward compatibility for existing APIs.
scope: Migrate ~2 million customer records (~150GB) from PostgreSQL to MongoDB. Implement dual-write and CDC for seamless data synchronization, maintain API stability, and ensure performance parity. Configure MongoDB indexes and validation checks for exact data parity. Out of scope: non-customer-related tables, UI changes, or external APIs.
success_criteria: 100% parity between PostgreSQL and MongoDB before cutover
Zero data loss and <50ms (p95) read latency after migration
Dual-write and rollback mechanisms validated within 2 weeks
Successful feature-flag-based rollout with backward-compatible API

user_stories.title: Design MongoDB schema for flexible country-specific customer data
user_stories.i_want: to define a MongoDB schema that supports variable country-specific fields
user_stories.so_that: we can store regulatory data without future schema migrations

acceptance_criteria.given: a set of international customer requirements
acceptance_criteria.then: it supports fields like My Number or VAT ID per country without altering other documents

user_stories.title: Implement CDC pipeline for backfill from PostgreSQL to MongoDB
user_stories.i_want: to configure and monitor CDC for incremental data migration
user_stories.so_that: customer data stays synchronized during dual-write period

acceptance_criteria.then: changes are captured and mirrored into MongoDB with zero data loss

user_stories.title: Implement dual-write mechanism to both PostgreSQL and MongoDB during transition
user_stories.i_want: writes to be persisted in both databases during migration
user_stories.so_that: we can ensure data consistency while validating MongoDB performance

acceptance_criteria.given: a write request to the customer profile API
acceptance_criteria.then: data is saved successfully to both PostgreSQL and MongoDB

user_stories.title: Add feature flag to enable gradual rollout of MongoDB-backed customer data
user_stories.i_want: to control the rollout of MongoDB reads and writes through feature flags
user_stories.so_that: migration can occur without downtime or customer impact

acceptance_criteria.then: requests start reading from MongoDB instead of PostgreSQL

user_stories.title: Perform data validation and parity check between PostgreSQL and MongoDB
user_stories.i_want: to ensure all customer records match between both databases before cutover
user_stories.so_that: we guarantee zero data loss and maintain data integrity

acceptance_criteria.then: it reports 100% parity or highlights discrepancies for review

user_stories.title: Create rollback procedure to revert API reads/writes to PostgreSQL within 1 hour
user_stories.i_want: a tested rollback plan for database migration
user_stories.so_that: we can quickly restore service in case of MongoDB issues

acceptance_criteria.then: API is reverted fully to PostgreSQL operations within 60 minutes

user_stories.title: Optimize MongoDB indexes for read/write performance
user_stories.i_want: to define and create indexes that meet <50ms read latency targets
user_stories.so_that: customer data queries perform as efficiently as PostgreSQL

acceptance_criteria.given: a set of customer query patterns
acceptance_criteria.then: read latency meets <50ms p95 performance under expected traffic
